messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Automated page fired -> latency.p99 > 2.5s for service=model-serving-eu-west across 3 hosts. alert_id=ALRT-1799004321, severity=page
jen_oncall: ack; I'm awake, grabbing dashboards now :eyes:
matt_sre: saw this spike on the kvcache eviction chart, rate jumped ~6000req/s -> evictions up. link: https://dash.internal/r/serving/eu-west/evictions
jens_oncall: typo — jen_oncall here. matt, can you confirm if there were any recent deploys or config changes in the window (10:22-10:28)?
matt_sre: nothing in prod-deploys but there was a quantization batch job on the staging cluster that finished ~10:20. unrelated, but also seeing elevated tokenization latencies on the tokenizer nodes (tokenizer-eu-1/2)
olivia_ml: ML infra -- we did roll a small model variant to canary eu-west at 10:18 (low-traffic). It shouldn't affect serving variant selectors but will check routing logs now
jen_oncall: good. I'm going to push a temporary routing fallback to route 10% traffic to model-variant-small to relieve hot path. command: `infractl route override set --service model-serving-eu-west --percent 10 --target model-variant-small`
incident-bot: Change request queued: override id OV-1799004321. Applying...
sre-bot: OV-1799004321 applied on 3 hosts. Confirming traffic shift :white_check_mark:
matt_sre: after override, p99 dropped from 2.7s -> 2.1s within 40s. evictions trending down but still noisy
jen_oncall: excellent. Can someone check downstream caches (redis shard 07) — I see elevated miss rate which could explain extra KV thrash
matt_sre: redis shard 07 shows high IOQL for writes, looks like an eviction cascade. Starting a small scale read-replica promote to spread read load: `redisctl promote-replica --shard 07 --count 1`
olivia_ml: routing logs show some tokenization fanout spikes from a small set of customers hitting longer sequences. Recommend adding a short-term prefix cache for long prompts if we see recurrence
jen_oncall: customer impact: preliminary - about 0.6% of API requests in eu-west saw > p99 latency, roughly 2% of active sessions experienced slow responses. No customer pages yet. I'm drafting a short status note for support: "We experienced elevated latency in eu-west; mitigation in progress; limited user impact."
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by jen_oncall (oncall). Escalations paused.
matt_sre: monitoring autoscaler: no extra gpu preemptions. Looks isolated to kvcache + tokenizer I/O contention
jen_oncall: next steps: 1) keep fallback route for 15m, 2) let redis replica promotion settle, 3) collect traces for slow requests and tag with trace_id. matt, olivia — can you capture flamegraphs and top spans?
matt_sre: capturing spans now — `tracectl capture --service model-serving-eu-west --filter p99 --duration 5m --out /tmp/trace-1799004321.zip`
olivia_ml: grabbing model-level traces and tokenizer profiles, will upload to infra bucket and link in thread when ready
jen_oncall: 10:46 update: p99 stable ~2.0s, p95 back to normal. Keeping OV-1799004321 in place for 12 more minutes then will remove if stable
incident-bot: Reminder: OV-1799004321 scheduled to auto-remove in 12m unless extended
jen_oncall: removing override early to test rollback — `infractl route override remove --id OV-1799004321`
sre-bot: OV-1799004321 removed. Traffic returned to original routing :inbox_tray:
matt_sre: after removal p99 ticked to 2.3s for a minute then settled to 2.0s. redis shard 07 IOQL normalized after replica promotion.
jen_oncall: summary for handoff -> oncall-next: incident id ALRT-1799004321. Root cause likely kvcache eviction cascade amplified by tokenizer fanout (long sequences) and a transient redis IO hotspot. Mitigation: temporary routing override to small variant, redis replica promote. Customer impact limited (~0.6% requests >p99). Traces and artifacts: /artifacts/trace-1799004321.zip, /artifacts/tokenizer-profile-1799004321.json
oncall-next: ack and taking follow-up. Will keep an eye through the next 30m and review eviction thresholds with infra tomorrow.
jen_oncall: thanks — filing a follow-up ticket for permanent fixes (kvcache guardrails, redis shard autoscale, tokenizer backpressure): TICKET-3456
oncall-next: noted. closing pager and marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident ALRT-1799004321 marked mitigated by jen_oncall at 1799005221
jen_oncall: postmortem note: short blip, good quick mitigation. We'll validate autoscale triggers and add an alert for redis IOQL next week. Good work everyone :clap:
